Service 01

LAWN CARE, MOWING & EDGING

A lush, healthy, evenly cut lawn creates an unforgettable first impression. We deliver precision mowing, weed whacking, and razor-sharp perimeter edging.

  • Precision Striping & Mowing: Sharp blades cut at the ideal seasonal height for root strength and drought defense.
  • Clean Edge Trimming: Flush trimming along curbs, walkways, garden beds, trees, and fence perimeters.
  • Walkway Debris Blowing: High-powered leaf blowers clear all patios, driveways, and sidewalks before we leave.
  • Flexible Schedules: Weekly, bi-weekly, or seasonal scheduled routes tailored to your grass growth rate.

Service 02

SNOW PLOWING & WINTER MAINTENANCE

Michigan winters demand dependable, proactive snow management. We keep driveways, commercial parking lots, and walkways clear and safe all season long.

  • Residential Driveway Plowing: Cleared early before your morning commute with care around lawn edges.
  • Commercial Parking Lot Clearing: Zero-downtime snow removal keeping your business accessible and liability-free.
  • Sidewalk Clearing & Salting: Eco-friendly ice melting applications to eliminate slip and fall hazards.
  • 24/7 Blizzard Response: We monitor radar round the clock to dispatch trucks as soon as snow triggers accumulate.

Heavy Duty
Service 03

DEBRIS & BRUSH REMOVAL

Overgrown brush, tree branches, piles of lawn waste, and yard clutter ruin curb appeal and attract pests. We chop, load, and haul it away.

  • Downed Branches & Yard Waste: Complete removal of deadwood, tree clippings, and organic piles.
  • Fence Line & Brush Clearing: Clearing tangled weeds, wild buckthorn, and invasive growth along perimeters.
  • Environmentally Responsible Disposal: Wood and organic yard debris are diverted to regional mulching and compost centers.
  • Zero Heavy Lifting for You: Our crew loads the trailers, rakes the site clean, and hauls everything away.

Spring & Fall
Service 05

SPRING & FALL SEASONAL CLEANUPS

Preparing your landscape for the changing seasons is vital for long-term turf health and preventing mold or rot under thick snow.

  • Spring Thaw Cleanups: Raking winter dead grass, sticks, and gravel spread during snow plowing.
  • Fall Leaf Vacuuming & Haul: Deep leaf clearing from turf, landscape beds, window wells, and patios.
  • Garden Bed Refresh: Perennial cutbacks, edging freshening, and winter preparation.
  • Lawn Aeration Prep: Relieving soil compaction to allow water and fertilizer deep into the root zone.

24/7 Rapid Response
Service 06

EMERGENCY STORM DAMAGE RESTORATION

Severe thunderstorms, ice storms, and high wind can cause dangerous tree branches to collapse across driveways, roofs, and structures.

  • 24/7 Priority Emergency Line: Call 989-544-0791 immediately for rapid emergency response.
  • Downed Tree & Limb Chainsawing: Careful bucking of fallen timber without further property impact.
  • Driveway & Access Clearance: Opening vital access routes for homeowners and emergency vehicles.
  • Debris Hauling & Tarping: Full site cleanup and debris removal so repairs can proceed smoothly.
